_help: Newest first. type is one of: added, changed, fixed, removed.

items.text: Next: survival mining, inventory, sound.
Day and night cycle with sun, moon, stars and sunsets; day length and time of day in settings.
Real-time shadows from the sun and moon.
Animated water: waves, sky reflections, sun glints.
HDR rendering with bloom and ACES tone mapping.
Pixel-edged clouds drifting across the sky.
Wind: leaves and plants sway.
Flora: Bellgrass, Emberbloom, Frostbell and the glowing Glowcap (also grows in the hollows).
Fireflies at night; drifting light motes in the hollows.
Held block, view bob, sprint FOV kick, block-break particles.
Cinematic flyover behind the title screen.
Graphics setting: Fancy / Fast (press G).
Chunk meshing runs on background Web Workers.
Default render distance is now 8 chunks.
Chunks could fail to appear when every mesh worker was busy.
Switching worlds could leave stray chunks from the previous world.
Playable in the browser at [vibratingcode.github.io/hollowstone](https://vibratingcode.github.io/hollowstone/).
Endless seeded world in 16×16×128 chunks, streamed around the player.
Biomes: Meadow, Duskwood, Dunes, Frostland, Peaks, Shore, Ocean.
Caves and the hollows: deep caverns lit by Lumen crystals with real block light.
19 original blocks with procedurally painted textures.
Smooth ambient occlusion, sky light, gradient sky and underwater fog.
Walking, sprinting, sneaking, swimming and flying with voxel collision.
Break, place and pick blocks; 9-slot hotbar and block picker (E).
Automatic saves in IndexedDB; world list to create, play and delete worlds.
Settings: render distance, field of view, mouse sensitivity.
Dev hub site with devlog, roadmap board, and changelog.
Originality rules to keep the project legally distinct.
Initial roadmap: milestones M0 to M7.
